questions.stem:

```text
x ← 0
total ← 0
REPEAT 8 TIMES
{
   x ← x + 1

   {
      total ← total + x
   }
}
DISPLAY (total)
```

What is displayed as a result of running the code segment?

options.why: Only values divisible by 2 are added.
x is increased before the check in each pass.
Correct. x goes from 1 to 8; the multiples of 2 among them are added.
total adds the values, not 1 each time.

questions.explanation: The values of x are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8; the multiples of 2 add to 20.

concat joins its arguments in the order given.

questions.stem: A network has computers P, Q, R, S, T, U. The direct connections are: P–Q, P–S, P–T, Q–R, Q–S, R–T, R–U. What is the minimum number of connections that must fail for computer R to be unable to communicate with computer Q?

options.why: After that many failures a path still remains.
Correct. Removing 2 well-chosen connections separates R from Q; removing fewer always leaves a path.
